title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the wavelength as 4 m using the wave speed and period.

title: Total distance traveled
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total distance traveled by particle P as 28 cm.

title: Wave period determination
description: Important: Identifies the period from the angular frequency in the vibration equations.

title: Wave speed calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates wave speed using the time for the first wave to reach P.

title: Amplitude during interference
description: Important: Determines the amplitude at P during superposition as the absolute difference of source amplitudes.

title: Distance from SHM
description: Important: Correctly calculates distances traveled during simple harmonic motion intervals using amplitude and number of oscillations.

title: Timeline of events
description: Important: Correctly identifies the times when each wave reaches P and the start of interference.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Fails to maintain consistent units (m, cm, s) throughout the calculation, leading to incorrect numerical answers.

title: Superposition error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes amplitudes add during interference, rather than finding the correct amplitude for the standing wave.
